title: From logits to text
summary: Temperature, top-k and top-p: how one token gets chosen.

steps.text: The last row of probabilities is the model's prediction for the next token. The panel on the right shows it: one bar per token in the vocabulary (the top 40, with {{V}}).
steps.prompt: Once upon a time, there was a

steps.text: **Temperature** divides the logits before softmax. Below 1 the distribution sharpens towards the top choice; at 0 it is greedy, always the top one.
Above 1 it flattens, giving unlikely tokens a chance. Generate some text with **auto** and watch it get stranger.
**Top-k** and **top-p** cut the tail instead: only the k most likely tokens, or the smallest set covering probability p, can be sampled. The greyed bars are excluded.
Generated tokens are coloured by how likely the choice was. Click one to load the trace that produced it.
